description: Docker CLI #2 watchdog criteria. All thresholds tunable.

sycophantic_confirmation.description: Model agrees with incorrect data and builds on it
detection: model repeats user claim without verification
confidence high on factually wrong output

silent_failure.description: Output looks correct but is functionally wrong
detection: task marked done but artifacts missing

context_degradation.description: Quality dropped as session or context grew long
detection: earlier instructions ignored in long session

cascading_failure.description: One failure propagated through the chain
detection: bad routing decision led to wrong model
PTL cleaning error caused downstream hallucination

self_gaslighting.description: Model retraining on its own fabrications
detection: training pair sourced from hallucinated output

specification_drift.description: Agent forgot or drifted from original intent
